identity.evidence: The published logo file is byte-identical (SHA-256 verified 2026-11-27) to the Revolut mark file distributed by Simple Icons at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/develop/icons/revolut.svg — the documented source of this published file (web/assets/logos/README.md lists 'revolut' among the Simple Icons files used for startup logos). The Simple Icons file carries the title 'Revolut' and is the documented Revolut mark in the Atlas logo set; Revolut's homepage itself is bot-walled from this environment, so identity rests on the Simple Icons attribution and the reviewed Revolut record.
